title: proxy: Fix two-pass dissection of coalesced packets
description:
Create conversation data for the PROXY dissector when transported over TCP (not UDP, which is connectionless.) Use conversation_set_conv_addr_port_endpoints() so that when subdissectors get a conversation they retrieve one associated with the proxied values.

As part of this, have the PROXY dissector set itself as the dissector for the main conversation, so that conversation_set_conv_addr_port_endpoints() can be called for all frames on the conversation.

Otherwise, coalesced packets with both a PROXY header and data for a dissector like HTTP that calls conversation_set_dissector() would on the second pass call only the payload dissector and not the PROXY dissector (heuristic or not), failing dissection.

This also means that the proxied ports are used (as well as the outer server port) for TCP deciding what dissectors to call. In some cases (if the outer TCP port is not already assigned to a dissector), this means that "Try heuristic dissectors first" will not have to be enabled.

For the LOCAL command, use the outer connection transports and call the subdissector.

Fix #15714's remaining issue. Fix #19261
